lines: Kahan ho tum, chale aao, mohabbat ka taqaza hai.
couplets.en: Where are you, come to me, for love asks it of you.

lines: Hamein duniya se ghabra kar tumhein dil ne pukara hai.
couplets.en: Overwhelmed by the world, my heart has called for you.

lines: Tumhari berukhi ek din hamari jaan le legi.
couplets.en: Your coldness will be the death of me one day.

lines: Qasam tumko, zara socho, ki dastoor-e-wafa kya hai?
couplets.en: I beg you, think a moment about what it means to stay true.

lines: Na jaane kis liye duniya ki nazrein phir gayin humse.
couplets.en: I wonder why the world turned its eyes away from me.

lines: Tumhein dekha, tumhein chaha, qusoor iske siwa kya hai?
couplets.en: I saw you and loved you, what other fault was mine?

lines: Na hai fariyad honton par, na aankhon mein koi aansoo.
couplets.en: No plea rests on my lips, no tear in my eyes.

lines: Zamane se mila jo gham, use geeton mein sunaya hai.
couplets.en: I have put the sorrow the world gave me into song.
